coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 13 of 17 ground-truth variable items (76%, rounded): consistent chronological splits, input and forecast lengths, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, epoch limit with early stopping, batch size, normalization, cycle-index generation, MSE, MAE, and visualization outputs. Example batch sizes are treated as illustrative rather than mandatory.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the specified RTX 4090 GPU with CPU-only computation. Omits the RevIN enable/disable flag and synthetic-data generation parameters; Gaussian parameter initialization is not synthetic-data generation. The optimizer specification is inconsistent: it names Adam but specifies an AdamW implementation, and training settings vary with input length rather than remaining fixed.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion describing a trained CycleNet capable of accurate forecasting or visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
